newsitem.title: FINLAND: Markka opens unchanged in Helsinki after ERM-link.
newsitem.headline: Markka opens unchanged in Helsinki after ERM-link.

text.p: The Finnish markka opened unchanged against the German mark on Monday after being pegged to Europe's Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) on Saturday.
The markka opened at 2.9860 bid per German mark, unchanged from its Friday close in Helsinki.
At 0605 GMT, it traded at 2.9865/95 per mark.
The markka was virtually unchanged against other currencies, too. At 0630 GMT, it was bid at 0.8835 per French franc compared to 0.8822 last Friday and at 5.7321 against the Ecu compared to 5.7207.
The markka was at 0.6941 against the Swedish crown (0.6920 last Friday) and at 4.5746 per dollar (4.5715).
Currency dealers said early trade was quiet with operators cautious.
